mapper.select:
select
, count(1) count from corgi_evaluation e where e.user_id = #{userId} and e.status != 'deleted' and e.check_status = 'pass' group by e.tag order by count desc limit #{start}, #{size}

select a.id, a.apply_user_id applyUserId, a.approval_user_id approvalUserId, a.type from corgi_date_apply a where a.status = 'agree' and (a.approval_user_id = #{userId} or a.apply_user_id = #{userId}) and not exists( select 1 from corgi_evaluation where evaluator_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted' and apply_id = a.id)
select sum(score) / count(score) from corgi_evaluation where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted' and check_status = 'pass' order by id desc limit 30
select score from corgi_evaluation where tag = #{tag} and score is not null order by id desc limit 1
select count(distinct evaluator_id) from corgi_evaluation where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted' and check_status = 'pass'
select count(1) from corgi_evaluation where user_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted' and check_status = 'pass'
